abbreviations.definition: single crochet 2 together, a decrease (2 sts become 1): [insert hook in next st, yo and pull up a loop] twice, yo and pull through all 3 loops

rows.instructions: With Colour 1, ch 30, join with sl st to form ring, taking care not to twist the chain.
Ch 1, sc in same ch as join and in each ch around. Place a stitch marker in the first st — work in a continuous spiral from here on, do not join or turn. (30 sc)
Sc in the back loop only of each st around. (30 sc)
Sc in the back loop only of each st around. (30 sc)
Sc in the back loop only of each st around. (30 sc)
Sc in the back loop only of each st around. (30 sc)
Sc in the back loop only of each st around. (30 sc)

Sc in each st around. (30 sc)
Sc in each st around. (30 sc)
Sc in each st around. (30 sc)
Sc in each st around. (30 sc)
Place a marker in next 4 sts (gusset sts). 2 sc in each of next 2 sts, sc in each of next 2 sts, sc in each st around to end. (32 sc)
2 sc in each of next 2 sts, sc in each of next 4 sts, sc in each st around to end. (34 sc)
2 sc in each of next 2 sts, sc in each of next 6 sts, sc in each st around to end. (36 sc)

Sc in each st to the marked gusset sts. Skip the next 10 sts and leave them unworked (thumb gusset). Ch 2 to bridge the gap, then sc in each remaining st around, working the last 2 sts of the round into the 2 ch just made. (28 sc)

*sc2tog, sc in each of next 2 sts; rep from * around. (6 sc)
*sc2tog, sc in next st; rep from * around. (4 sc)
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread the tail through the front loop of each remaining stitch, pull tight to close the fingertip opening, and weave in the end.
Join yarn in a skipped gusset st. Sc in each of the 10 skipped gusset sts, then sc 2 sts evenly across the bridge chain. Place a stitch marker — work in a continuous spiral from here. (12 sc)
